findings.highlight: I can’t do that to Sakura
findings.evidenceJa: 万が一にもそんな事になったら桜に悪すぎる
findings.governingReading: if that should happen even by the slightest chance, it would be far too wrong toward Sakura
findings.explanation: The English keeps Shirou’s correction toward concern for Sakura but removes the emphatic improbability and hypothetical structure.

findings.evidenceJa: しきりに時計を盗み見る
findings.governingReading: repeatedly stealing glances at the clock
findings.explanation: Saber’s exact exposure of Shirou’s furtive behavior becomes a neutral description of looking often.

findings.highlight: I do not mind if you say so
findings.evidenceJa: シロウがそう言うのなら私は構いませんが
findings.governingReading: if that is what Shirou says, Saber has no objection
findings.explanation: The English copies the Japanese condition into an unnatural construction that blurs Saber’s pointed, formally polite concession.

findings.evidenceJa: 廊下から、あわただしく藤ねえが飛び込んできた
findings.governingReading: Taiga hurriedly bursts in from the hallway
findings.explanation: The staging, abrupt entry, and visible agitation are reduced to ordinary running.
mirror moon generalizes the specific medicine Taiga leaves to fetch.
The English reports only Sakura’s location and removes the medical event.

findings.evidenceJa: とりあえず安心しなさい
findings.explanation: Taiga’s direct instruction to calm down is weakened into merely limiting worry.
The source warns that Sakura must not overdo it; the English changes this into an external group choosing whether to push her.

findings.highlight: That should provide plenty of energy for her all by itself
findings.evidenceJa: それだけで桜ちゃんも元気がでるからね
findings.governingReading: just having Shirou stay with her will cheer Sakura up or restore her spirits
findings.explanation: An intimate claim about Shirou’s presence encouraging Sakura becomes mechanical, awkward energy provision.

findings.highlight: it has lots of “those” kind of people
findings.evidenceJa: 血気盛んな若い衆を抱えている藤ねえの家
findings.governingReading: Taiga’s household has a number of hot-blooded young men
findings.explanation: mirror moon replaces the concrete reason the Fujimura home keeps medical supplies with a vague quoted euphemism.

findings.highlight: I have to go check on Sakura
findings.governingReading: although he does not understand the situation
findings.explanation: The English omits Shirou’s explicit limit on what he currently knows.

findings.highlight: I put the medical thermometer down
findings.explanation: The alternate branch repeats the substitution of putting the thermometer down for shaking it.

findings.evidenceJa: ベッドで横になる桜の顔を見る
findings.governingReading: looks at Sakura’s face as she lies in bed
findings.explanation: The alternate branch again removes the face being observed and Sakura’s position.

findings.highlight: She has a slight cold, and she collapsed in the dressing room because she felt dizzy after staying in the bath for too long
findings.evidenceJa: 軽い風邪と、長湯からきた立ち眩みだったようだ
findings.governingReading: it appears to have been a mild cold together with lightheadedness caused by a long bath
findings.explanation: Shirou’s provisional diagnosis is presented as settled causal fact.

findings.highlight: I guess I got dizzy since I was so nervous
findings.evidenceJa: 緊張してお風呂に入ったら、のぼせたみたいです
findings.governingReading: she seems to have become overheated after entering the bath while nervous
findings.explanation: The alternate branch again deletes the bath and changes overheating into dizziness directly caused by nerves.
The repeated care instructions retain the same inapt literal English collocation.

findings.highlight: you can rest easy until then
findings.evidenceJa: それまでゆっくりしてろ
findings.explanation: A practical instruction to rest becomes an idiom meaning not to worry, shifting care from bodily rest to reassurance.
